column3: The passive pouring out of love is recast with God as the active subject; being given the Spirit is likewise recast actively.
The repeated still is expressed once.
The participle boasting is rendered as the finite “we also rejoice.”
The active passing of death is rendered passively as “was passed on.”
“Was given” specifies the arrival of the law.
“The result” and “sin” supply the comparison’s ellipsis.
The verb “brought” is supplied; justification of life is rendered as “justification and life.”
